name: Barrow Hill, Cornwall, England
description: An invented Cornish site: a stone circle, a holy well, a barrow, a swamp and a lonely petrol station, all drawn from south-east Cornwall. The circle is Duloe stone circle, the well St Cuby's Well beside it, the swamp the Looe estuary at Sandplace; the petrol station is a composite of the area's old forecourts. Pinned on Duloe stone circle.
